title: IacResourceContribution
description: An infrastructure-as-code resource declaration (Terraform resource, Kubernetes manifest object, Helm template output, CloudFormation resource, Pulumi, Bicep, Ansible task). Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (techno-specific KSs, Rule 1): `IacScanKS` today (multi-tool); future tool-specific KSs (e.g. `TerraformScanKS`, `PulumiScanKS`) populate the same envelope. The `iacTool` discriminator tags the source vocabulary.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the IaC source file. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

name.description: Resource local name (Terraform local name, Kubernetes metadata.name, ...).

moduleSymbol.description: Identifier of the enclosing IacModule contribution (e.g. module path or chart name).

attributes.description: Universal-core resource attribute map (free-form). Provider-neutral keys live here; tool-specific metadata goes in `nativeAttributes`.

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Tool-specific facts that don't fit the universal core (e.g. Terraform `lifecycle` block, k8s `metadata.annotations` flavour, CloudFormation `DependsOn` shape).
